ai.title: Context pruner: strip Tools prefix, add no-imitate summary note
ai.summary: Context pruner drops `Tools: ` prefix from tool summaries in compacted history. Adds explicit note to summary prompt: condensed markers (`[USER]`, `Read files:`) are log-only, not response format. Covers agents context compaction via context-pruner.ts. Prevents agent from imitating summary markers instead of issuing real tool calls.

eli5.text: When an AI agent runs out of space to remember the whole conversation, it creates a shortened summary. Previously, that summary listed tool actions with a 'Tools: ' label, which the AI sometimes mistook as a format to copy in its actual responses. Now the summary drops that label and includes a clear instruction telling the AI those condensed markers are just a log of what happened, not something to repeat. This stops the AI from writing out fake tool calls as plain text instead of using the correct tools.

ai.title: Freebuff 0.0.29 release bump for CLI distribution packaging
ai.summary: This release bumps the freebuff package version from 0.0.28 to 0.0.29 in the CLI release package.json manifest, marking a packaging update for the distributed binary. It ships alongside context compaction improvements, Fireworks 5xx fallback reliability, and an SDK reasoning token suppression fix described in the release notes. The change touches only the version field within the freebuff/cli/release package, which governs the published CLI distribution metadata. No functional code changes are included in this specific commit.
ai.evidence: The commit modifies freebuff/cli/release/package.json, changing the version field from 0.0.28 to 0.0.29 as part of a release bump (commit cbb5551a).

eli5.text: Freebuff 0.0.29 delivers more reliable AI conversations and cleaner code assistance. This update makes Fireworks model connections more dependable by automatically switching to a backup service when the main provider has any server trouble, not just specific errors. It also fixes a glitch where hidden internal reasoning could leak into your conversations when using certain AI models. The context pruner now strips extra tool labels from summaries and tells the assistant clearly that condensed notes are for tracking only, so it won't accidentally copy that shorthand into real responses. Users upgrading get smoother streaming answers and summaries that behave correctly during long coding sessions.
